verdict.rationale: The evidence shows generic watchlist screening ([flagright-docs-36]) and an API for batch-creating business users ([flagright-docs-19]), but nothing states that business entities are screened. Nothing covers linked ownership, beneficial owners, or association risk context that an analyst could inspect. Generic screening and business-user ingestion are adjacent features, not this story's capability.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can screen business entities and inspect their linked ownership or association risk context
